name: OPC-UA/DA
description:
OPC is one of interoperability standard for the secure and reliable exchange of data
in the industrial automation space and in other industries.

OPC DA (Data Access) is a classic COM-based specification that works only on Windows.
OPC DA is widely used even though it isn’t the newest and most efficient data communication
specification out there. This is mainly because of older devices that only support the OPC DA.

OPC UA is the next generation beyond the classic OPC specification, a platform-independent,
service-oriented architecture specification that
integrates all functionality from the existing OPC Classic specifications,
providing a migration path to a more secure and scalable solution.

For more about OPC UA/DA we introduce you to read the [OPC Foundation site](https://opcfoundation.org/),
and some useful blogs, such as

1. [What is OPC](https://opcfoundation.org/about/what-is-opc/)
2. [What is OPC DA](https://plcynergy.com/opc-da/),
3. [What is OPC UA](https://opcfoundation.org/about/opc-technologies/opc-ua/).
4. [WHEN TO USE OPC-UA VS OPC-DA](https://www.vertech.com/blog/opc-ua-vs-opc-da).

taosX could pull data from OPC server by a OPC connector plugin.

Check the help message in each part to see the details.
